hero.oneLiner: The deck positions GRM Overseas as a five-decade-old basmati rice processor and exporter ("among the Top 5 Rice Exporters Globally", 55+ countries) that is converting its rice franchise into a domestic packaged-staples FMCG house of brands under "10X", funded by a Rs. 136.5 crore warrant raise and an acquisitive 10X Ventures platform.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Described as "A Prominent Food FMCG player, boasting a Widespread Footprint in both domestic and global markets" with "An enduring legacy of over 5 Decades, originating in 1974", framed as a "Transformation from a Rice Trader to one of the leading Rice Processor".
- International: "It is among the Top 5 exporters of basmati rice globally", "GRM is among the largest exporters in the MENA Region", with "Widespread Global presence in 55+ countries" and distribution offices at UK and Middle East.
- Two distinct go-to-market models: the International Business is "Own Brands 5% | Private Label 95%" (basmati rice), while the India Business is "Own Brands 100%" in consumer staples (Rice | Atta | Edible Oil). Deck footnotes the India split with "* Balance constituted by revenue from other unbranded products".
- Structure: GRM Overseas Ltd (standalone) with 100% WOS subsidiaries GRM International Holdings Ltd, UK and GRM Fine Foods Inc, USA; India FMCG sits in GRM Foodkraft Pvt Ltd, a "Subsidiary (91.48% shareholding)".
- Industry backdrop quoted as tailwind: Indian Packaged Food Market Rs. 6.1 Tn (2019) → 10.2 Tn (2024) → 17.3 Tn (2029E); target market "~ Rs. 7.4 Tn / 72.3% of Total Packaged Foods Market (includes Packaged Staples & Other Packaged Foods)".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Deleveraging trend shown: Debt to Equity (X) 1.5 (FY23) → 1.2 (FY24) → 0.9 (FY25) → 0.6 (FY26); Interest Coverage Ratio (X) 5.4, 4.9, 5.8, 5.4 across FY23-FY26.
- FY26 returns quoted as Return on Equity 12.6% and Return on Capital Employed 20.2%; LT Credit Rating "A (Stable)" from Acuite.
- "GRM Overseas raised Rs. 136.5 Crores from prominent investors and promoters through the issue of share warrants on preferential basis to provide a cushion for future growth of the company"; fund-raise objectives listed as Inorganic Growth, Expanding Product Range and Operational Efficiencies. (Elsewhere the deck says 10X Ventures "raised Rs. 136 crores for further expansion".)
- Balance sheet is working-capital heavy: Mar 26 Inventories Rs. 435.1 Cr and Trade Receivables Rs. 577.0 Cr against total assets of Rs. 1,160.2 Cr, funded largely by Short-term Borrowings of Rs. 365.3 Cr (Long Term Borrowings only Rs. 0.7 Cr).
- Equity Share Capital rose from Rs. 12.0 Cr (Mar 25) to Rs. 41.4 Cr (Mar 26) with Other Equity Rs. 413.6 Cr → Rs. 560.2 Cr; the deck does not state a dividend policy.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition] "GRM acquired Single Largest Stake (44% stake) in Swmabhan Commerce Pvt Ltd, the parent company of Virat Kohli-Backed Digital-First Coffee Brand 'Rage Coffee'" - listed as the 1st investment/acquisition under 10X Ventures.
- [Distribution] Domestic network stated as 240+ Suppliers, 176 Distributors and 103K+ Touch Points (Kirana Stores), addressing "1.3 Billion Target customers" through both General Trade and Modern Trade.
- [Marketing] "Onboarded Bollywood superstar Salman Khan as our Brand Ambassador", plus CGI ad campaigns for 10X Zarda King and "Continuous BTL Marketing efforts".
- [Channel] Tie-ups cited with Jio Mart, Walmart, CityMall, DealShare and Udaan domestically; internationally, listings via big stores like ASDA, Walmart, Carrefour and Tesco.
- [Industry] Basmati Rice Exports from India (Industry) shown at 29,848 (FY21) rising to 50,137 (FY26) with "CAGR 11%" - the deck does not state the unit for this series on the extracted slide.
